slots.why_needed: Provide a high-impact visual system for the reference Corporate/Brochure site.
slots.narrative_function: Connection, scale, direction and calm operational confidence.
slots.subject: Conceptual global trade scene at a modern seaport.
slots.alt_en: Conceptual cargo vessel moving between modern ports at sunrise
slots.alt_ar: مشهد مفاهيمي لسفينة شحن تتحرك بين موانئ حديثة وقت الشروق

provenance.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing
Asset type: bilingual corporate brochure website hero background
Primary request: a cinematic, premium global trade and logistics scene that feels contemporary, trustworthy, and visually striking at first glance
Scene/backdrop: a vast modern seaport at blue hour transitioning into warm sunrise, elegant container geometry, distant cranes, calm sea, subtle luminous route lines suggesting international connection without looking like a literal map
Subject: the architecture, port, cargo movement, and light itself; no identifiable people
Style/medium: highly realistic cinematic commercial photography with refined editorial art direction, not science fiction
Composition/framing: ultra-wide landscape composition; strong central depth; balanced usable negative space on both the left and right outer thirds so bilingual UI copy can sit on either side; clear focal point slightly below center; suitable for responsive cropping
Lighting/mood: deep navy shadows, warm amber highlights, soft volumetric atmosphere, controlled glow, high dynamic range, luxurious but credible
Color palette: midnight navy, petrol blue, warm amber, subtle copper
Materials/textures: realistic steel, glass, water reflections, atmospheric haze
Constraints: no text, no letters, no logos, no flags, no watermarks, no fake certificates, no impossible machinery, no dominant subject at the extreme edges
Avoid: cyberpunk neon overload, fantasy, oversaturation, excessive lens flare, stock-photo look, people posing for camera
provenance.human_review: Approved for the fictional Alpha reference project only.
